title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 29 September 2026
description: Today's stories: Treasurer Chalmers' better-than-expected federal budget result ahead of this afternoon's RBA rate decision, a major Coomera Hospital expansion under Queensland's Hospital Rescue Plan, and new Gold Coast transport funding replacing the cancelled light rail stage four. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
